name: @zeldrisho/pi-packages
description: Monorepo for independently published Pi extensions.

scripts.ready: vp check && vp test --coverage && vp run pack:dry-run && vp run test:packages
scripts.build:anubis-worker: vp exec tsc --ignoreConfig packages/pi-web-fetch/src/challenges/anubis-worker.ts packages/pi-web-fetch/src/challenges/anubis-solver.ts --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --outDir packages/pi-web-fetch/workers --skipLibCheck --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --types node
scripts.build:aws-waf-worker: vp exec tsc --ignoreConfig packages/pi-web-fetch/src/challenges/aws-waf-worker.ts packages/pi-web-fetch/src/challenges/aws-waf-solver.ts --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --outDir packages/pi-web-fetch/workers --skipLibCheck --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --types node
scripts.pack:dry-run: for package in packages/*; do (cd "$package" && vp pm pack -- --dry-run) || exit; done
